rationale: A is clearer and more robust because the roll list is the single source of truth; frame state is derived rather than duplicated across several mutable counters and flags that must remain synchronized. Its validation handles tenth-frame reset semantics cleanly, and its scoring loop applies one consistent frame model across all ten frames. B works but carries needless state, includes an effectively unused `_frame > 10` condition, and spreads tenth-frame rules across counters, accumulated pins, a strike flag, and roll-history indexing, making future maintenance more error-prone.
